# browser

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/component/browser"
```

Package browser is the pick\-from\-a\-list screen: labels on the left, the selected item's detail on the right, tab to move focus between them. It owns only the browsing state; what a choice means is the caller's.

<a name="Chosen"></a>
## type [Chosen](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/browser/events.go#L5>)

Chosen is the event of an item being chosen: enter on the list. Item is the item under the cursor.

```go
type Chosen struct{ Item Item }
```

<a name="Dismissed"></a>
## type [Dismissed](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/browser/events.go#L8>)

Dismissed is the event of esc on the list: close without choosing.

```go
type Dismissed struct{}
```

<a name="Item"></a>
## type [Item](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/browser/browser.go#L23-L26>)

Item is one row: what the list prints and what the preview shows for it. Detail is called on render, so an expensive body is only built when shown.

```go
type Item struct {
    Label  string
    Detail func() string
}
```

<a name="Styles"></a>
## type [Styles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/browser/browser.go#L70-L73>)

Styles are how the list pane paints its labels; the preview is the item's own text.

```go

    Cursor lipgloss.Style // the label under the cursor
    Label  lipgloss.Style // every other label
}
```
